newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor up on speculation, lower arrivals.
newsitem.headline: India castor up on speculation, lower arrivals.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery climbed to 1,188/1,189 rupees per quintal from 1,183/1,184 rupees on the back of fresh speculative buying on Wednesday, dealers said.
Lower arrivals sparked bull support but overseas buying stayed low. Gujarat arrivals fell to 32,000/33,000 bags (75 kg each) against 50,000/55,000 bags reported on Tuesday.
"Meanwhile foreign buyers were demanding Indian castor oil at 680 dollars per tonne while Indian offers were at 690 dollars," one operator said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 342/343 rupees per 10 kgs amid limited activity ahead of the union budget scheduled on Friday.

But sentiment was firm on expectations that the Indian government may hike import duty on edible oils to 30 percent from 20 percent. Imported palm-oil slid by 1/2 rupees at 282 rupees per 10 kg following weak trend in the world market.
In Rajkot spot ground oil was steady at 515/517 rupees per 15 kg.
